topic: Disabling captive portal via core API
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on how to disable a captive portal. It was determined that the functionality could be controlled via the core API, specifically using a PUT request to update the portal settings.

[p1] requested assistance disabling the captive portal for Joe&TheJuice (JJ) because the core API returned captive portal data during a ping call. A sample cURL method was provided showing how to set `enabled="bool"` to disable it.

After attempting the process, [me] reported that the initial attempt using the provided ID failed with a 404 error but later confirmed that the feature appeared to be disabled.
decisions: The captive portal was successfully disabled.
action_items: [p1] will check if the captive portal is now disabled.
